# AOSHA Platform | منصة أوشى الشاملة

> AOSHA is an enterprise digital ecosystem in Saudi Arabia integrating four operational tracks: Entity Classification (Six Stars), HSSE Management Systems (OSH, Civil Security, Environment), Field Inspection & Auditing (with photo evidence & automated CAPA), and Training & Qualifications (Moodle LMS).

## Core Operational Tracks
- [Track 1: Entity & Factory Classification (Six Stars)](https://aosha.sa/#track-1): Advanced Six-Stars performance rating framework evaluating operational risk, compliance track record, and verified digital evidence.
- [Track 2: HSSE Management Systems](https://aosha.sa/#track-2): Centralized management for Occupational Safety & Health (OSH), Civil Security, Emergency Evacuation, and Environmental sustainability.
- [Track 3: Inspection, Auditing & Reporting](https://aosha.sa/#track-3): Mobile digital checklists, geo-tagged photo observations, automated CAPA corrective workflows, and instant PDF executive reports.
- [Track 4: Training & Qualifications (LMS)](https://aosha.sa/#track-4): Comprehensive LMS for trainers, learners, interactive courses, and instant QR-verified digital certificates.

## Integrated Educational Portal
- [AOSHA Moodle LMS Portal](https://lms.aosha.sa): Direct enterprise access for interactive courses, certification validation, and qualification pathways.

## Evaluation & Standards
- [Six Stars HSSE Framework](https://aosha.sa/#six-stars): Proprietary excellence framework assessing facilities into Excellent (10 pts), Good (7 pts), and Needs Improvement (5 pts) based on monthly digital audit findings.
- [Legal Status & Disclaimer](https://aosha.sa/#faq): Private professional standard developed by AOSHA Saudi Arabia for benchmarking and organizational maturity.
